evidence.statistic: Per-test/platform p80 of ordinary category-matrix run totals; p80 nearest-rank successful observed overhead per platform
evidence.fixedOverheadPopulation: Successful CategoryMatrixShard jobs when available; otherwise successful UmbrellaBaseline jobs. Overhead is job wall time minus test-run wall time.
evidence.configurationStagePolicy: Dedicated testConfigurationArgs stages are recorded separately and excluded from ordinary category-matrix projections.

configurationStageEvidence.projectionPolicy: Recorded separately and excluded from ordinary category-matrix projections.

limitations: Projections use historical per-test p80 durations and measured job overhead; they are estimates, not guarantees.
Assignments must project strictly below target minus the 2 minute safety margin.
Dedicated testConfigurationArgs stages are retained as separate evidence and do not reduce ordinary category-matrix projections.
Methods in fixtures containing NUnit Order attributes are assigned together so ordered setup and state remain available.
Tests without samples on a platform contribute zero to that platform because they were not executed there.
When explicitly enabled, unmeasured active tests use the maximum measured duration from their class/platform (or platform-wide maximum).
